title: Diophantine approximation with primes in an arithmetic progression
summary: Let $α\in \mathbb{R} \setminus \mathbb{Q}$, $β\in \R$, $N \in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 1}$ and $ Δ\in (0, 1/2)$. For any real $y$, let $\|y\|$ denote the distance from $y$ to the nearest integer. In the first part of this paper, we show that given two coprime integers $u, v \ge 1$, there are infinitely many primes $\ell \equiv u \bmod v$ such that $ \|α\ell - β\| \ll_v \ell^{-1/4} \log^{8} \ell. $ In order to prove this result we first prove the following general theorem and then deduce the above as a corollary.
